openRisksCycle2: RESOLVED (was code-reviewer-3.md #1): lane split on resume does NOT occur. Batch dir is keyed off the PlatformEvent storageUrl/CorrelationId (re-supplied identically on resume), not the per-invocation progress context; checkpoint carries no storage pointer. Verified our flows publish via shared CollectorNdjsonPublisher (TenableIoFindingsFlow.cs:480 / TenableIoAssetsFlow.cs:453) and resume via shared CollectorResumeRunner + CreateProgressContext(flowEvent) (TenableIoResumeRunner.cs:43,102). Mirrors Falcon's proven DUAL_MODE split mechanism. The reviewer's concern came from the local-runner's per-timestamp dump dir (test harness), not production.

Minor (optional hardening): redundant combinedRun truth sources; CurrentPage vs lane-local page divergence; 'FindingsInProgress' magic string x4 -> promote to a constant (typo would silently re-pull assets).
acceptedRisks: A3: ~3x findings volume (Spark/postgres throughput) mitigated by egress batching but not proven from code; user running tests.
Population-window mismatch: assets last_assessed vs findings last_found are not coextensive -> a tail of asset_id=null findings (LEFT-join + no-asset-struct guard tolerate).
